NONE: A1 to stop living or existing, either suddenly or slowly
› informal If a machine, battery, or phone dies, it stops working, usually because it has no power.
（通常因為沒有電而）停止運轉，報廢

C: › a shaped piece or mould (= hollow container) made of metal or other hard material, used to shape or put a pattern on metal or plastic
› US also or old use UK dice a small cube (= object with six equal square sides) with a different number of spots on each side, used in games involving chance

example: Twelve people died in the accident.
十二人在此次事故中喪生。
She died of/from hunger/cancer/a heart attack/her injuries.
她死於饑餓／癌症／心臟病／傷病。
It is a brave person who will die for their beliefs.
願為信念而死的人稱得上是勇敢者。
I would like to die in my sleep (= while I am sleeping).
我願在睡夢中死去。
Many people have a fear of dying.
很多人害怕死亡。
Our love will never die.
我們的愛將永不消逝。
She will not tell anyone - the secret will die with her.
她不會告訴任何人——這個秘密會爛在她的肚子裡。
He died a violent death.
他死於非命。
My grandmother died a natural death (= did not die of illness or because she was killed), as she would have wanted.
我祖母壽終正寢，這是她所希望的結局。
The engine just died on us.
台引擎剛好報廢在我們手裡。
I'm sorry I didn't reply to your text - my phone died.
對不起，我沒有回你的簡訊，我的電話沒有電了。

NONE: 以失敗告終，以失敗落幕

example: The play, like so many before it, died the death after a week.
那齣戲與此前的很多戲一樣，在一周之後以失敗告終。

NONE: › If something, especially a sound, dies away, it gradually becomes reduced until it stops existing or disappears.

example: The sound of his footsteps gradually died away.
他的腳步聲漸漸消失了。

NONE: › the process of cutting shapes from plastic by pressing with a sharp knife on one or more layers of plastic
C2 If a sound or activity dies down, it becomes quieter or less obvious.

example: It was several minutes before the applause died down.
過了好幾分鐘掌聲才平息下來。

NONE: › If a belief or way of behaving dies hard, it takes a long time to disappear, and is not given up easily.

example: Old habits die hard.
積習難改。
See also
diehard
If anyone found out that I took the money, I'd die of shame.
如果有人發現錢是我拿的，我會羞愧死的。

NONE: › If a group of plants, animals, or people dies off, all of that group dies over a period of time.
B2 to become less common and finally stop existing

example: Dinosaurs died out millions of years ago.
數百萬年前恐龍就已經滅絕了。
It's a custom that is beginning to die out.
這是一種正在消失的習俗。

NONE: › to make something by pouring liquid metal, plastic, etc., usually under pressure, into a mould (= hollow container)
› someone who is unwilling to change or give up their ideas or ways of behaving, even when there are good reasons to do so

example: a diehard conservative/fan
頑固的保守派／鐵杆擁躉

U: C1 [ U ] a type of heavy oil used as fuel

C: › [ C ] any vehicle, especially a train, that has a diesel engine

example: a diesel engine
柴油引擎
My new car runs on (= uses) diesel.
我的新汽車用柴油。

C or U: B1 [ C or U ] the food and drink usually eaten or drunk by a person or group

NONE: › Diet food or drink contains less sugar or fat than the usual type, and often contains an artificial sweetener.
（食物或飲品）健康的，低脂的，低糖的
› to limit the food and/or drink that you have, especially in order to lose weight
（尤指為減肥而）節食，控制飲食

C: B1 [ C ] an eating plan in which someone eats less food, or only particular types of food, because they want to become thinner or for medical reasons
S: › [ S ] a particular type of thing that you experience or do regularly, or a limited range of activities
程式，套路；有限的幾種活動

example: Diet varies between different countries in the world.
世界各國的飲食各不相同。
a healthy/balanced/varied diet
健康／均衡／多樣化的飲食
Rice is the staple diet (= most important food) of many people in China.
在中國大米是很多人的主食。
The children seem to exist on a diet of fried food.
孩子們好像離不開油炸食品。
I'm going on a diet next week and hope to lose ten pounds before Christmas.
下周我要節食，希望在聖誕節之前能減掉十磅。
a crash/strict/calorie-controlled diet
突擊／嚴格／控制熱量的節食
The doctor put me on a low-salt diet to reduce my blood pressure.
為了降低血壓，醫生規定我要低鹽飲食。
He was brought up on a diet of political propaganda from birth.
他一出生就開始接受老一套的政治宣傳。
Network TV only offers a diet of bad reality shows every night.
每天晚上電視播放的都是幾部劣質的真人秀。
You should be able to reduce your weight by careful dieting.
透過小心控制飲食你應該可以減輕體重。
Dietary habits can be very difficult to change.
飲食習慣很難改變。
Do you have any special dietary requirements?
你有甚麼特殊的飲食要求嗎？

NONE: › someone who is trying to lose weight by dieting
› the scientific study of the food that people eat and its effects on health
› a person who scientifically studies and gives advice about food and eating
飲食保健專家，營養學家，營養師
